Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues modeled seasonal changes in net CO2 in Alaska in a landscape grid of 1 square kilometer (km2) cells and again in a grid of 10 km2 cells, which are finer resolutions than most models of net CO2 have achieved. The researchers concluded that variations in the landscape affect net CO2 in ways that most models are too coarse to capture. 题目 48% - 1 0.56% Question 12 Which finding from the researchers' study, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?
